turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to start working out again but I can only manage three short sessions a week.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's plenty to make progress. Would you rather focus on strength with weights, or on cardio like running and cycling?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, can you wait? My friend is talking to me. Keep quiet until I come back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alex, which of these two pans do you think is better?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The heavier one. Thin pans burn everything.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's almost twice the price though.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It'll last you ten years. The other one will be scratched by spring.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, you've convinced me. Can you hold it while I find a basket?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi again. You were choosing between weights and cardio for your three sessions.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Strength. I want to feel stronger carrying the groceries.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great goal. Start with squats, push-ups and rows, three sets each, and add weight slowly.
